question: By what name is the speaker known in the world as Bhṛṅgapāda?
premises: The speaker identifies himself with the name Bhṛṅgapāda.
This identity is well known in the world.
The declaration is made to the boon-granting goddess.
inference: The speaker is renowned in the world as Bhṛṅgapāda.
uncertainties: The function of te at the beginning is syntactically ambiguous in isolation.
plain_english: O granter of boons, I am also well known in the world as Bhṛṅgapāda.
